programme.title: Sorority Wars
programme.desc: Katie Parker (Lucy Hale) and Sara Snow (Phoebe Strole) have been friends since childhood. They enter college together, where Katie is a prized legacy candidate for the Delta sorority, which was co-founded decades ago by her mother, Lutie (Courtney Thorne-Smith) and Summer (Faith Ford), whose own daughter Gwen (Amanda Schull) now leads the Deltas on campus. Events occur during pledge week to cause a rift between Katie and the Deltas, which leaves Sara as a Delta pledge and Katie out in the cold. Katie joins the rival Kappa sorority, and the rivalry splits not just Katie and Sara, but extends all the way into the Delta alumnae association led by Lutie and Summer.

She displays her abilities while helping out a local doctor and caring for Mrs. Stafford-Smith (Nancy Linehan Charles), an elderly woman who recently had a stroke.

programme.desc: When Mark goes for a visit with his uncle he's thrown into a world he knows not much about. Little does he know it'll be a world he's going to have to become very familiar with. programme.title: For One Night
programme.desc: Inspired by the true story of an African American teenager who shook up a small town where high school proms had been racially segregated for decades. Amid the protests of the community and with the help of a newspaper reporter who returns to her hometown to cover the story, the two women are able to reverse decades of racist tradition and make history, at least for one night. The movie is based on events that occurred in Taylor County, Georgia in 2002.

programme.title: Jack
programme.desc: Jack, in full puberty, not only has to deal with his parents' divorce, but also feels his world is falling apart when his dad tells him he is living with a man. He slowly comes to terms with his own feelings when the girl he has a crush on turn out to have a gay dad as well and his best friend's parents end up not having the perfect marriage Jack thought they had.

programme.title: Hogfather

programme.title: Hogfather

Meanwhile, at the Tooth Fairy's castle, Mr Teatime's evil plan is underway. Sir David Jason and Marc Warren star in this spectacular Christmas treat. Part 2 of 2. This programme plays in HD on Sky One HD Channel 175.

programme.title: Fear the Walking Dead
programme.desc: In Los Angeles, a city where people come to escape, shield secrets, and bury their pasts, we follow this mysterious outbreak as it threatens to disrupt what little stability high school guidance counselor Madison Clark and English teacher Travis Manawa have managed to assemble. The pressure of blending two families while dealing with resentful, escapist, and strung out children takes a back seat when society begins to break down. A forced evolution, and survival of the fittest takes hold, as our dysfunctional family finds they must either reinvent themselves or embrace their darker histories.

programme.title: Strange Relations
programme.desc: Drama with Paul Reiser. When a Jewish New York psychologist is diagnosed with leukemia, his mother reveals that he was adopted from a Catholic teenager in the UK, leading to a journey of self-discovery.

programme.title: Hard Ground
programme.desc: Billy Bucklin escapes while being transported to Yuma prison and plans to form an army of desperadoes to control the Mexican border. To finance his band, he robs a stagecoach, kidnaps a beautiful woman to be sold into prostitution, and steals an army payroll wagon. An aging lawman persuades the governor to parole his brother-in-law, now serving a 20-year prison term for murder, to assist him and his green deputy to destroy the marauders.

programme.title: The Circuit
programme.desc: Al Shines, former king of the US race car track circuit, has a hard time starting his own team, once he's fired by his sponsor Robin Cates. Robin hired Al's immature daughter Kylie Shines instead. She resents Al's inevitable 'absence' as a widowed father, as well as the reigning champion, equally young but professionally vetted Kid Walker. Kylie tries to prove herself against Kid while having an on-off affair with him. Cates's marketing strategy dictates his intentions to manipulate Walker and both Shines racers.

programme.title: Too Late to Say Goodbye
programme.desc: Bart Corbin's wife Jenn dies in their home, apparently suicide, as the police believes. While he moves in with young sons Taylor and Trevor at brother Bobby's, her sister Heather starts a relentless campaign, without any clue, to make the police believe Bart must have murdered her and had an affair with practice secretary Dara.

programme.desc: The rise and fall of the Enron company, as seen from the perspective of employee Brian Cruver, based on his book.

programme.title: The Wild Girl
programme.desc: Ned Giles, an aspiring news photographer, joins the 1932 Great Apache Expedition on the search for a young boy, the son of a wealthy Mexican land owner who was kidnapped by wild Apaches. Ned finds himself on an unexpected and perilous journey through rugged terrain, when a captured wild Apache girl must be exchanged for the kidnapped boy.

programme.title: You've Got a Friend
programme.desc: A recently-orphaned 12 year old boy moves to a new town to live with his aunt and uncle, and finds an unlikely mentor in the town loner, who helps him build the soap box racer he dreamed of crafting with his dad.

programme.title: Gentle Ben 2: Black Gold

programme.title: The Reagans
programme.desc: Ronald Reagan turned from a liberal movie star to an exceptionally conservative politician and stunned the nation when he became governor of the largest state. The Reagans skilfully used American myth-making to rise to power. This documentary also takes a look at the relentless shift to the right of business, prompting Reagan to become a champion of a contained government.

programme.title: The Reagans
programme.desc: An analysis of Reagan's view of the race issue and his role as an advocate of authority and order who used racist strategies to win elections. The similarities with the current political landscape and the tactics employed by some Republicans are striking. Nancy also comes to the fore as a political force.

programme.title: The Virgin Queen
programme.desc: Elizabeth remains a threat in her childless Catholic sister's eyes. Queen Mary is still on the throne and with her harsh politics, she excessively pursues the persecution of Protestants, even of her sister. Queen Mary knows that her sister has a large number of supporters in England, and therefore, she imprisons Elizabeth in the tower and later puts her under house arrest. When Queen Mary surprisingly dies from a tumor, Elizabeth becomes Queen of England. William Cecil, her advisor, warns Elizabeth of the dangers that the married Robert Dudley may, due to their inappropriate relation, cause as a member of the Privy Council.

programme.title: The Virgin Queen
programme.desc: The pressure on Elizabeth grows as there is still no marriage and consequently no heir to the throne. Elizabeth fears that her cousin Mary Queen of Scots, recently widowed, might claim her right to the throne of England. However she is resolute in thinking that she can rule alone. Meanwhile she continues to meet Robert Dudley. When his wife dies, rumors spread that Elizabeth might be behind her death. Details of a plot to replace Elizabeth with Mary are uncovered by Walsingham. Even the Duke of Norfolk seems to be involved and is subsequently sent to the tower.

programme.title: The Forbidden Kingdom
programme.desc: The Forbidden Kingdom (2008) is a kung fu wuxia film directed by Rob Minkoff and starring Jackie Chan and Jet Li. Teenager Jason, who lives in South Boston, is crazy about kung fu. One day he makes an amazing discovery: in one of Chinatown shops he finds the legendary staff which belongs to the great warrior Monkey King. The magic staff sends Jason on an adventure to ancient China, where he joins an army of highly skilled warriors gathered to free their imprisoned king.

programme.title: An Old Fashioned Thanksgiving
programme.desc: In the late 1880's, a widowed mother of three struggles to keep her family intact and to put food on the table. The oldest daughter sends a letter to her estranged, very wealthy grandmother urging her assistance, much to her mother's disapproval. When the grandmother arrives, old wounds are opened but eventually healed. From a story by Louisa May Alcott. Stars Jacqueline Bisset, Ted Atherton, Tatiana Maslany, Helene Joy, Paula Boudreau, and Michael Barbuto.

programme.title: Sea Beast / Troglodyte
programme.desc: Mythic creatures emerge from the sea to feast on the residents of a fishing village.

programme.title: Teens
programme.desc: The film showcases three 14-year-old girls: Dawn (Miriam McDonald), Becca (Megan Park), and Hannah (Alexis Dziena). Hannah soon finds herself on the receiving end of peer pressure from her friends to engage in oral sex with Nick Hartman, a nice boy whom Hannah likes. She believes that she has to behave in a particular fashion in order to fit in with her more sexually-active peers.

programme.title: Answered by Fire
programme.desc: Canadian RCMP officer Zoe Brennan, Australian Federal Policeman Mark Waldman and a young East Timorese translator named Ismenio Soares are brought together by the UN's fateful effort to give the Timorese a voice in their own future. In the chaotic run-up to the vote, these initially reluctant partners become real friends. But when the UN evacuates in the post-ballot rampage, Mark and Zoe are forced to abandon Ismenio and his family to a nightmarish fate. Haunted by guilt, the two westerners each find their way back to Timor, driven to make amends to the people they tried - and failed - to protect.

When local neighbor Julia Prentice, the wife of a famous movie actor, adopts a baby in full view of the show-business media, the parenthood craze hits its peak. Soon after, Julia is found lying dead in Lucy's swimming pool, with Lucy and her husband labeled as suspects. Now Lucy must determine the truth to clear the name of both herself and her family.

programme.desc: Female US president Sheridan is killed from a mile by a masterly sniper who leaves no trace. La Mangouste's commando team kills the couple, tortures him and anyone known to have crossed his path but looses him again. General Carrington tells him his identity is an elaborate fake to intrude the conspiracy which uses the collateral victims at every terrorist strike, all tattooed with Roman numerals, like his XIII.

The desert plant Arrakis "Dune" has become an imperial capital, still thanks to its monopoly on the spice. Now Paul Muad'Dib Atreidis' son and daughter are coming of age, the stage is set for a new power game. The spice guilt has prepared a secret weapon: perfect clones.

programme.title: Children Of Dune
programme.desc: As conspiracies to gain political power abound, Paul's power base is eroded from within and his highly ambitious sister, Alia is gaining a political foothold. Born aware of her ancestral memories, Alia is considered an abomination by the Bene Gesserit. The Lady Jessica, her mother returns to Dune (Arrakis) to visit her grandchildren Leto II and Ghanima. When one particular ancestor begins to possess Alia, Lady Jessica has to take refuge. Leto II and Ghanima devise a plan toward salvation.

programme.title: Children Of Dune

programme.title: Vimbldono turnyras. Highlights Day 10
programme.desc: Wimbledon is more than just a tennis tournament — it's a summer tradition, a slice of British culture, and one of the most iconic sporting events in the world. Held every year in London, England, usually in late June to early July, it's where the best tennis players on the planet come to battle it out on the famous grass courts of the All England Club. It's actually the oldest tennis tournament in the world, dating back to 1877, and it's still the only Grand Slam played on grass — the fastest and most unpredictable surface. That's part of what makes it so exciting. Matches are intense, fast-paced, and full of surprises. Wimbledon is packed with unique traditions that make it stand out. Players are required to wear all white on court — no exceptions. The crowd enjoys strawberries and cream, and you won't see flashy ads around the court — it's all about the game. And of course, there's the Royal Box, where you might spot celebrities or even members of the British Royal Family watching the action. From rising stars to tennis legends, everyone dreams of lifting the famous Wimbledon trophy. There's something magical about seeing players walk onto Centre Court, hearing the roar of the crowd, and witnessing moments that go down in sports history. Whether you're a tennis fan or just love great sports drama, Wimbledon is a must-watch — classy, thrilling, and full of unforgettable moments.

Held every year in London, England, usually in late June to early July, it's where the best tennis players on the planet come to battle it out on the famous grass courts of the All England Club. It's actually the oldest tennis tournament in the world, dating back to 1877, and it's still the only Grand Slam played on grass — the fastest and most unpredictable surface. That's part of what makes it so exciting. Matches are intense, fast-paced, and full of surprises. Wimbledon is packed with unique traditions that make it stand out. Players are required to wear all white on court — no exceptions. The crowd enjoys strawberries and cream, and you won't see flashy ads around the court — it's all about the game. And of course, there's the Royal Box, where you might spot celebrities or even members of the British Royal Family watching the action. From rising stars to tennis legends, everyone dreams of lifting the famous Wimbledon trophy. There's something magical about seeing players walk onto Centre Court, hearing the roar of the crowd, and witnessing moments that go down in sports history. Whether you're a tennis fan or just love great sports drama, Wimbledon is a must-watch — classy, thrilling, and full of unforgettable moments.

programme.title: Vimbldono turnyras. Highlights Day 12
programme.desc: Wimbledon is more than just a tennis tournament — it's a summer tradition, a slice of British culture, and one of the most iconic sporting events in the world. Held every year in London, England, usually in late June to early July, it's where the best tennis players on the planet come to battle it out on the famous grass courts of the All England Club. It's actually the oldest tennis tournament in the world, dating back to 1877, and it's still the only Grand Slam played on grass — the fastest and most unpredictable surface. That's part of what makes it so exciting. Matches are intense, fast-paced, and full of surprises. Wimbledon is packed with unique traditions that make it stand out. Players are required to wear all white on court — no exceptions. The crowd enjoys strawberries and cream, and you won't see flashy ads around the court — it's all about the game. And of course, there's the Royal Box, where you might spot celebrities or even members of the British Royal Family watching the action. From rising stars to tennis legends, everyone dreams of lifting the famous Wimbledon trophy. There's something magical about seeing players walk onto Centre Court, hearing the roar of the crowd, and witnessing moments that go down in sports history. Whether you're a tennis fan or just love great sports drama, Wimbledon is a must-watch — classy, thrilling, and full of unforgettable moments.

programme.title: Kingdom of the Blue Whale
programme.desc: Supported by the National Geographic Society, the world's eminent blue whale scientists embark on a revolutionary mission: they'll find, identify and tag California blue whales, use the DNA samples to confirm the sex of individual whales - then rejoin the massive creatures' stunning migration when they collect at a chimera known as the Costa Rica Dome. These experts have observed, firsthand, courtship behavior among the whales at the moving mass of krill and currents 500 miles off the coast of Costa Rica. Now they hope to find - and record - the Holy Grail of blue whale science … the breeding and calving grounds of the biggest mammals in the sea.

programme.title: Kingdom of the Polar Bears
programme.desc: As the Arctic changes faster than ever, a team of polar bear guides prepares for an epic journey; a first-ever attempt to follow the bears on the sea ice of Hudson Bay. In this high-stakes high-reward venture, they will document the secret world of bears, a mysterious and disappearing realm that is the bears key to survival. Life on the ice is a critical time for these bears. It also remains undocumented, deemed too dangerous for humans to follow, hinted at only through aerial reconnaissance and satellite collar research. The team, armed with traditional ecological knowledge and the latest 4K camera technology, will witness never- before-seen seal hunting strategies and document rapid adaptations to climate change, including whale predation and open-water hunting.

programme.title: Wild Arabia
programme.desc: Discover Saudi Arabia's rugged landscapes where wildlife ingeniously adapts to extreme conditions. Amid sun-scorched terrain, creatures endure searing sun, thin air, and toxic gases. Explore bone caves, and marvel at rock art depicting local fauna—deadly scorpions, raucous baboons, charming chameleons, and endangered leopards. Their resilience mirrors the harsh beauty of Saudi Arabia's environment.

programme.title: Desert Lions: Surviving At Skeleton Coast
programme.desc: In this true story, lion researcher Dr. Philip Stander follows three orphaned lion cubs from birth to adulthood as they navigate the complexity of survival in one of the world's most unforgiving environments, Namibia's deadly Skeleton Coast. He gets up close and personal to unlock secrets of their world and witness the amazing adaptability of these special cats.

programme.title: Wild Arabia
programme.desc: In Oman's ancient seas and deserts, life is abundant yet challenging for its diverse wildlife. Journey with local scientists through landscapes adorned with frankincense trees, horned vipers, and tail-lashing lizards. Witness beach patrols with turtles and explore caves hosting unique fish. Along the Arabian coast, spinner dolphins, whales, and turtles enrich Oman's vibrant marine life.

programme.title: Predator Bloodlines
programme.desc: She leads the formidable Sausage Tree Pride, an ensemble of buffalo-slaying huntresses. That is, until the migration crosses their prime domain and they demonstrate ultimate adaptability and switch prey species. But the pride has been compromised after a split-away group left their ranks and now she must muster her troupe to excel at motherhood while male coalitions complicate dynamics all around them.

programme.title: Predator Bloodlines
programme.desc: Identified by her burnt orange gaze, she leads a pride of five closely-related lionesses and their six offspring. They overcome every challenge as a precision unit: the gauntlet of the buffalo hunt or the upheaval of new males that could either decimate the prides ranks or offer her the chance to finally mother cubs. But desperate drought and crippling disease push the sisterhood to the absolute brink of survival.

programme.title: Predator Bloodlines
programme.desc: She overthrew the preceding ruler of North Clan in an unprecedented take-over, fighting her way up from a lowly rank to matriarch. She is both a ruthless battle commander, leading her clan in warfare against rivals and adversaries like lion, and devoted guardian to her clan and parent to her offspring.

programme.title: Wild Lapland
programme.desc: A lyrical portrayal of the enchanting, wild creatures who call Lapland home.

programme.title: Prairie Dog Manor
programme.desc: Follow the exploits of these cute creatures from northern New Mexico. "Prairie Dog Manor" showcases the unique behaviour of these special animals and highlights the different relationships that exist between the clan members from Valles Caldera National Preserve. Beginning with the prairie dogs preparing for the coming winter, Carl and the pups get ready for hibernation. But they face danger from an unlikely source as deadly predators forge an alliance to threaten every dog in the territory. Further episodes explore the mating season when the warm weather arrives and battles commence between the males to earn the right to mate with the females. Soon, the females are pregnant and new pups arrive and the whole cycle starts again.

programme.title: Perfect Predator
programme.desc: From their massive size, strength and stamina to their finely tuned hunting skills and unrelenting will to survive—sharks have evolved to be the perfect predator. But how do they do it? In this action-packed hour, unlock key evolutionary components that have kept these apex predators on top for millions of years.

programme.title: Austria's Wild Heritage - One Country Six National Parks
programme.desc: The second part focuses on the challenges of the future: How do the national parks deal with invasive species from outside and what success stories can be reported? For instance, in the Hohe Tauern National Park the previously extinct ibexes and bearded vultures have been reintroduced. In the Gesäuse National Park Avalanches created one of the most species-rich habitats, which rare butterflies like the Red Apollo colonize.

programme.desc: Public Panic. It's a hectic time for snake rescuers Simon, Sioux and Mbali in Durban. The summer heat and overdevelopment bring all sorts of snakes into close contact with the public, and they must manage the panic to ensure the safety of all.

programme.title: Race to Winter
programme.desc: As the first light of spring touches snow-covered landscapes, the race begins. Across fjords, forests, mountains and tundra, animals emerge from hiding to take advantage of summer's fleeting generosity. But the clock is ticking, and winter is never far away. Brown bear mothers supervise their wayward cubs; puffins reunite in lifelong pairs atop perilous ledges; a polar bear mother searches for food in a land where the ice has receded and her usual prey has vanished. As summer fades, the mighty moose faces wolves in the silent snow. Arctic foxes raise their young and scavenge in brutal temperatures, surviving on scraps others cannot digest. Each species is tied to the land and to each other in a delicate web of survival. In this race against the cold, only the most remarkable endure.

programme.title: Supersized Sharks
programme.desc: Has a small island in the middle of the South Pacific become a drive-thru burger joint for the world's largest Tiger Sharks? Luring the giants to their boat, shark biologists Lauren Meyers, Charlie Huveneers and Adam Barnette investigate and are surprised to discover that beef is not the only unusual item on the menu.

programme.title: Cannibal Sharks
programme.desc: National Geographic Wild. Cannibal Sharks pulls in two of the world's leading shark experts to unpack and analyze the mounting evidence that shark-on-shark attacks happen a lot more than we ever realized.

programme.title: Raging Bullshark
programme.desc: For years, the smaller, unremarkable-looking bull shark has come in third behind the great white and tiger sharks when it comes to deadly attacks on humans. But as climate change warms the world's waters, and its territory begins to spread, the bull shark enters the ring to prove its worth and leave with the title of the world's most dangerous shark.

programme.title: Return of the White Shark
programme.desc: Cape Cod — America's Playground — is a newly emerging hotspot for a top predator. Great Whites are appearing in increasing numbers, when for centuries there were none. Through spectacular imagery, we'll see how the landscape of Cape Cod has changed over time, and what is luring Great Whites in record numbers.

programme.title: Sharks of the North
programme.desc: Sightings of great white sharks have been on the rise in Atlantic Canada. Alanna Canaran, a passionate science educator and dive instructor, embarks on a mission to unravel the enigmas surrounding these magnificent creatures and is determined to dispel fear of sharks in Nova Scotians. As the journey unfolds, Canaran and her team dive into the history of human-shark relationships along the coast. Facing numerous challenges, including elusive sharks and treacherous weather conditions, the team perseveres. With sheer determination and a stroke of luck, they gather invaluable knowledge of these magnificent creatures, contributing to a better understanding of white sharks in Canada.

programme.title: Snakes in the City
programme.desc: Catching the world's deadliest snakes is no problem for Simon Keys and his partner Siouxsie Gillett, who round up Durban's ever-growing population of street snakes. With the summer heat enticing the snakes into the city, it's the duo's job to safely catch the slithering creatures and release them safely back into the wild. Entering homes, offices and even factories, the reclusive reptiles seek to find shelter in places you wouldn't think likely. From black mambas to cobras, Simon and Siouxsie have their work cut out as they race to help the residents of Durban stay safe from a potentially lethal snakebite.

programme.title: Snakes In the City Compilations
programme.desc: Simon and Sioux are amazed by the respect Indian locals have for their venomous scaled neighbors. The calls are pouring in, and Snake Shyam helps rescue a deadly Russell's viper tangled in netting. Shyam's son, Surya, is breaking concrete steps to help Simon and Sioux finally capture a rat snake. Then, the duo teams with Gowri Shanker to catch and release not one but two enormous king cobras.

programme.title: Attack of the Red Sea Sharks
programme.desc: Sharks have killed 3 tourists in Egypt in less than a year. What brought the sharks into shallow waters, away from their natural hunting grounds? This documentary investigates not just the attacks in the Red Sea, but also other unusual shark encounters around the world, including in Sydney and Florida.

programme.title: Shark Kill Zone
programme.desc: They may be the oceans top predators but sharks still face great challenges in grabbing a meal. This film travels to ten shark hot spots to reveal ten spectacular kinds of shark feeding behavior.We'll discover how the special conditions of each shark species' preferred hunting ground affects every aspect of their hunt, from their body design to their behavior.

programme.title: Backyard Bull Shark
programme.desc: Bull sharks are invading in a big way. Found in oceans worldwide, their bullish behavior has made them famous from coast to coast. And the seven seas aren't enough, they're taking over brackish waters and rivers, too! Warmer waters due to climate change mean bull sharks can expand their range even further… so the more we learn about them now, the better.

programme.title: World's Biggest Sharks
programme.desc: After a chance encounter with not one … not two … but three massive sharks, shark experts around the globe are on a quest to discover the world's biggest shark. Evidence of more super-sized sharks lurking below the surface leads them to the waters around the Florida Keys, elusive lagoons in French Polynesia, and remote locations surrounding the Hawaiian Islands. Their mission is to not only locate what might be the world's biggest shark but also to uncover the incredible forces that make some of these apex predators so massive. From highly evolved survival strategies, such as teamwork and hunting, to pupping sanctuaries, scavenging tactics and powerhouse genetics, discover how survival of the fittest breeds these behemoths of the deep.

programme.title: Rogue Shark?
programme.desc: In October 2018, the remote islands of the Whitsunday in Australia were rocked by a series of shark attacks. Incredibly, all the victims were attacked in the same small patch of ocean, no larger than four football fields. Was a rogue serial killer on the loose? Or was something new drawing sharks and humans into conflict?

programme.title: Ledo kelias
programme.desc: Norvegiška žiema toli gražu ne visiems padovanoja geras emocijas. Ledu padengti keliai kelia pavojų ir vieną po kito į šalikeles bloškia keliautojus. Sniege įstrigusias transporto priemones gali išvaduoti tik patyrę gelbėtojai, apsiginklavę specialia technika ir prietaisais. Gelbėjimo darbams tampant vis aktualesniems - Thordas, Bjornas, Jo Rogeris investuoja į naują techniką ir tikisi verslo suklestėjimo.

programme.title: Rise of the Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: Action-packed animation. Four pizza-loving brothers, Raph, Leo, Donnie and Mikey, are mutant turtles who live in the sewers under the streets of New York City. Raph is the oldest of the brothers and also their leader. Leo is the sword-swinging trickster of the team. Donnie is the smartest of the group and Mikey is the youngest brother and also the joker of the bunch. The adventures they go on help them discover their mystic ninja powers and understand the world around them. They learn to work better as a team of heroes. Skills they will need when faced with the enemies who wish to defeat the Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles.

programme.title: T.U.F.F. Puppy
programme.desc: The Rat Pack:When Keswick's cloning machine ends up in the wrong hands, Petropolis is overrun by Snaptraps looting and destroying everything in their path! Things look pretty desperate for T.U.F.F. when Snaptrap sends his clone army to destroy them, but Dudley has a few tricks up his sleeve, including a few extra Dudleys!Booby Trap:Bird Brain's discovery that he is the last blue-bottomed booby in Petropolis lands him on the endangered species list and, unfortunately, off T.U.F.F.'s "Most Wanted" list as they are not allowed to touch him with his newly acquired status! Will Dudley and Kitty be forced to sit idly by as Bird Brain plunders the town? Knowing Dudley and Kitty, not for long!

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender
programme.desc: Aang feels neglected as Katara and Sokka reunite with Bato, an old friend of their father's from the South Pole. They begin to reminisce on their times in the past while they wait for a message to arrive from their father; in which Aang believes Katara and Sokka will abandon him and go out to find their father should the message arrive. However, when the messenger gives Aang the message to give to Bato, Aang betrays his friends in a way Katara or Sokka could never imagine. However, when Zuko recruits a bounty hunter named June to track Aang down. His friendship is put to the test, as he must deal with the fact that he betrayed his friends while defending himself from yet another fight.

programme.title: The Loud House
programme.desc: In this crowded and chaotic household, Lincoln Loud is the only boy among his ten sisters. With eleven children under one roof, things get a little bit crazy sometimes, to say the least. This children's cartoon is fun and light-hearted, and Clyde, Lincoln's best friend, only adds to that. Clyde is an only child by contrast, and is jealous of Lincoln's abundance of siblings. Clyde also has a massive crush on Lori, who is Lincoln's oldest sister. However, she has a boyfriend, Bobby. Bobby, although not being particularly intelligent, has several different jobs, ranging from life guard, to security at a shopping centre.

programme.title: The Penguins of Madagascar
programme.desc: Watching too many ninja movies has brainwashed Leonard the koala. During the day, as he sleeps, he terrorizes everyone by sleepfighting (as opposed to sleepwalking). He makes the Rat King very angry by beating and humiliating him, and the oversized rodent is out for revenge. The penguins counter-program Leonard with a Lunacorn love movie marathon - is it enough to conquer all? // Private is left to babysit four adorable ducklings as the rest of the gang tries to crash a monster truck rally (unsuccessfully). The ducklings are a rowdy bunch and throw a party, inadvertently attracting party-crashing rats and wasps who attack the party food. Private and the ducklings become trapped in the lair with the food, and as the rats and wasps try to break in, Private must think fast - how can he combat both gangs at once?

programme.title: The Penguins of Madagascar
programme.desc: The penguins notice it's been quiet at night. Too quiet, something's amiss. The rest of the zoo animals have been sneaking out at night to spend time partying in the park! The plan to sneak out then return by morning to avoid getting caught by Alice is put in jeopardy when they run into the classic New York problem - a traffic jam in the tunnel. How in the world can a traffic jam get cleared out of the tunnel in time? // The penguins make a new friend in Dode the dodo bird, who they clone back into existence after a pesky bout of extinction. Having grown up with no natural enemies, Dode has no fear and it leads him to daredevilish behavior - the kind that can make you extinct over and over again. The penguins don't want to see this keep happening to their friend, they need to find a way to slow this crazy bird down!

programme.title: The Fairly OddParents: A New Wish
programme.desc: When her parents won't let her have french fries for every meal, Hazel wishes for unlimited fries. But Cosmo and Wanda fail to mention that eating so many magical fries would turn her into a potato! For help Cosmo, Wanda, and Hazel pay a visit to Mother Nature, where Hazel accidentally eats the prized "mother potato." Can she reconcile her fry fixation and get back in Mother Nature's good graces, or will Hazel have to face her wrath while stuck as a potato forever? // After Hazel and Marcus watch a scary movie Cosmo and Wanda lent them, paranormal incidents happen in the Wells home. Hazel wishes Marcus had a ghost tracking show to investigate. But Hazel, Cosmo, and Wanda learn the ghost is Ghost Pepper, a fairy actress whose spirit was trapped in the video tape. Fearing her capture will reveal fairies' existence, Hazel must convince Marcus to have an "exorcism" as a cover to send her back to Fairy World.

programme.title: The Fairly OddParents: A New Wish
programme.desc: When Hazel wishes to be 13 so that she can go see a PG-13 movie by herself, Cosmo and Wanda turn her into a teenager. They go the mall and have a blast doing "teenage things" while they wait for the movie. But, as a side effect of her wish, Hazel starts going through the fairy version of puberty: pasta puberty! As she struggles to deal with pesto pimples and mozzarella mood swings, Hazel wishes that Cosmo and Wanda would just get lost! They disappear, leaving Hazel to deal with the zany pasta puberty alone. // Hazel wishes to be a fairy to join Cosmo and Wanda at their Fairy Convention, but since it's against Da Rules, she settles on looking like a fairy instead. Once at the con, however, Hazel stumbles into the DMV booth and signs a "Fairy-fication" certificate, turning her into a real fairy! It also brings her anti-fairy into existence, who steals the certificate. Hazel, Cosmo, and Wanda must get the certificate back from her anti-fairy, or Hazel will be stuck as a fairy forever!

programme.title: The Fairly OddParents: A New Wish
programme.desc: Hazel, Jasmine, and Winn take an online BFF compatibility test. To their surprise, they fail! Nobody is fazed, except for Hazel, who overthinks the results and wishes that her friends could know exactly what's in her head. Cosmo and Wanda grant the wish, which lands all of them inside Hazel's mind. As they go through her mind like a museum, Hazel continues to overthink everything they see. Now, Hazel must overcome her negative thoughts and battle a literal mind worm to get her friends out! // When Hazel wishes she didn't have a gap in her teeth, the Tooth Fairy fills her gap with a talking tooth, Toothica. At first, she seems like a lot of fun, but when Toothica gets Hazel in trouble with her parents and plans a party in Hazel's mouth Hazel isn't invited to, Hazel decides she wants her gone! The Tooth Fairy, however, takes Toothica's side and is even set on honoring her at a gala. Hazel must find a way to prove Toothica is no good and get back her gap or be stuck with this rotten tooth forever.

Smotherly Love: Ma, an empty-nested mother possum, takes up residence in the Penguins Lair after they destroy her home during a battle with Hans the Puffin. She smothers the penguins with love and nurturing, and gets her new boys to behave by playing possum whenever necessary. The battle-hardened unit devolves into a bunch of softies, opening the door for Hans to take advantage. It looks like he has the upper wing, unless someone can make a play to stop him!

programme.title: The Penguins of Madagascar
programme.desc: A Kipper for Skipper: It's off to the races when Skipper agrees to give a day off from hard training to the first penguin who can bring him a kipper. Private, Rico, and Kowalski battle their way to a fish packing plant where they discover Officer X has become Fishmonger X. The deranged X sniffs out the fighting penguins, capturing them and hauling them off to the pokey. Can they rediscover the teamwork they had forsaken in order to escape? High Moltage: The penguins are determined to make opening day of their favorite action star's blockbuster movie! Private, however, has an itchy problem - he's turned hideous because he's molting! The penguins need his hypercute powers to knock Alice out and disengage her new zoo security system. The despondent bird does all he can to reconstruct his cuteness, but sadly his hypercute powers distort to cause a hyperalarming, hypervomitous mess!

programme.title: The Fairly OddParents: A New Wish
programme.desc: After Hazel makes her one-millionth wish, Cosmo and Wanda promise her one rule-free wish as a reward. But when their magic doesn't work, they take a trip to Fairy World to investigate and discover Dev has taken control. Fed up with living in Hazel's shadow, he's teamed up with Irep to give control of the Big Wand to anti-fairies and now kids all over the world have the opportunity to grant wishes rule-free. Before Hazel, Cosmo, and Wanda can stop Dev, he traps Cosmo and Wanda in butterfly net cages and sends Hazel back home without her fairies to help her. While in power, Dev changes Fairy World to his own image and liking, and even reveals the existence of magic to everyone on Earth. It's total chaos. With the fate of Fairy World on her shoulders, Hazel enlists the help of Jasmine, Winn, Antony, and a few magical friends from past wishes, to rise up against Dev and his anti-fairy forces. Hazel must save Cosmo, Wanda, Peri, and Fairy World, before making a very special rule-free wish.

programme.desc: Ray Fillet is attacked in Central Park by a mutant turtle! Donnie's busy with his robotics project: turning Metalhead into a spider-bot. Wingnut bursts in and tells the Turtles to come quick- Ray is hurt! A woozy Ray blames the Ninja Turtles, and the Mutanimals start a fight with the confused brothers. But when Ray's REAL attacker appears, a mutant snapping turtle named TOKKA, he fights everyone... until his watch starts beeping and he escapes. The Turtles tail him, ending up on the Staten Island ferry. After a big fight, Tokka's trapped. But while questioning him, Tokka explodes into OOZE, leaving only a baby turtle and his watch. Donnie's brothers ask him to hack it and find clues about Tokka, which he says is impossible! Later, Donnie gets a location pin from Wingnut and follows it to an abandoned factory on Staten Island. He finds her and ANOTHER TOKKA that he cleverly takes out! Donnie thinks they're safe until MORE Monster Mutanimals emerge! Could Donnie's day get any worse?

programme.desc: Liam Neeson, Monica Bellucci e Guy Pearce in un action di Martin Campbell. Un sicario, malato di Alzheimer, sceglie di non portare a termine un incarico quando scopre che l’obiettivo è una ragazzina. Si allea così con un poliziotto contro una spietata organizzazione criminale.

programme.title: Above Suspicion
programme.desc: Un agente dell'FBI sposato da poco deve cercare informazioni in una cittadina del Kentucky. L'uomo inizia una relazione con una donna del posto, la quale diventa la sua principale fonte d'informazione. La giovane vede in lui un modo per fuggire.

programme.title: Cinquanta sfumature di grigio
programme.desc: Eros e romanticismo per Dakota Johnson e Jamie Dornan, dal romanzo di E. L. James. Una studentessa viene sedotta da un uomo ricco e misterioso, che la coinvolge in un rapporto trasgressivo.

programme.title: Tramite amicizia
programme.desc: Alessandro Siani dirige e interpreta una commedia con Matilde Gioli, Max Tortora e Maria Di Biase. Per salvare il lavoro degli zii, Lorenzo deve usare la sua arte di 'amico professionista'.

programme.title: La leggenda degli uomini straordinari
programme.desc: L'avventuriero Allan Quatermain (Sean Connery) guida una squadra di eroi della letteratura popolare per fermare il folle piano di Phantom che vuole distruggere il mondo.

programme.title: Prendiamoci una pausa
programme.desc: Tre coppie di età diverse decidono di prendersi una pausa. Per Fabrizio è un dramma, per Valeria una rinascita. Valter la vive come un affronto di Fiorella dopo 30 anni, mentre i giovani Erica e Gabriel la usano per celare segreti e dubbi profondi.

programme.title: Anemone
programme.desc: Ray, ex soldato britannico, si è da tempo autoesiliato dalla famiglia e dalla società. Quando Jem, il fratello, parte alla sua ricerca, segreti nascosti e rancori sepolti da tempo vengono alla luce.

programme.title: Black Phone 2
programme.desc: Mentre Finn, ora diciassettenne, fatica a rimettere in sesto la sua vita, la sorella Gwen inizia a ricevere chiamate nei suoi sogni e ad avere inquietanti visioni di tre ragazzi perseguitati in un luogo noto come Alpine Lake.

programme.title: Una Di Famiglia - The Housemaid
programme.desc: Dopo essere caduta in disgrazia, Millie trova con sollievo un impiego come domestica presso Nina e Andrew, una coppia benestante. Ma presto si rende conto che gli oscuri segreti della famiglia sono molto più pericolosi dei suoi.

A rendere ancora piu' torbida la situazione ci pensera' l'ingresso in scena di Leila Williams, l'ossessiva ex-fidanzata di Grey, e di Elena Lincoln (Kim Basinger), la donna che inizio' Grey ai piaceri del sadomaso.

programme.desc: Julia Roberts e Hugh Grant nell'amabile commedia romantica di Roger Michell scritta da Richard Curtis. Un timido librario londinese incontra una diva di Hollywood... e sboccia l'amore.

programme.title: Le cose non dette
programme.desc: Un grande cast italiano per il nuovo successo di Gabriele Muccino sulla fragilità delle relazioni. Due coppie in crisi affrontano un viaggio a Tangeri che cambierà ogni equilibrio.

programme.title: Die in a Gunfight: Un buon modo per morire
programme.desc: Un uomo e la sua vecchia fiamma, dopo anni passati lontani e separati dalle rispettive famiglie, rivali da anni, per fare in modo che il loro amore sopravviva si troveranno a dover fronteggiare una schiera di assassini e malviventi.

programme.title: I peccatori
programme.desc: Nel delta del Mississippi per un vampire movie con Michael B. Jordan e Hailee Steinfeld. 1932: due gemelli afroamericani dal passato travagliato tornano nella città natale per aprire un night club per la comunità nera locale, ma devono affrontare un nemico terrificante.

programme.title: La Voce Di Hind Rajab
programme.desc: Il 29 gennaio 2024 gli operatori della Mezzaluna rossa ricevono la telefonata di Liyan Hamada, una quindicenne di Gaza intrappolata in macchina assieme a Hind Rajab, sua cugina di cinque anni, a seguito dell'attacco di un carro armato israeliano.

programme.title: Colette
programme.desc: Keira Knightley nel biopic sulla scrittrice Gabrielle Sidonie Colette. Protagonista della scena artistica nella Parigi della Belle Epoque, divenne un modello di emancipazione femminile.

programme.title: Al di la' dei sogni
programme.desc: Toccante film soprannaturale con Robin Williams. Un uomo viaggia dal Paradiso all'Inferno per salvare la moglie suicida, condannata alla dannazione eterna. Oscar agli effetti speciali.

programme.title: L'orchestra stonata
programme.desc: Thibaut è un direttore d'orchestra di fama internazionale che viaggia per il mondo. Quando scopre di essere stato adottato, scopre di avere un fratello che lavora in una mensa e suona il trombone in una banda di ottoni nel nord della Francia.

programme.title: La magnifica Lillian Hall
programme.desc: Jessica Lange, Kathy Bates, Jesse Williams e Pierce Brosnan nella toccante pellicola che racconta il crepuscolo di una diva di Broadway.

programme.title: L'ultimo dei Mohicani
programme.desc: Un Oscar all'epica avventura di Michael Mann con Daniel Day-Lewis. Nordamerica, 1700: durante le guerre coloniali, un indiano salva la vita alle figlie di un comandante inglese.

programme.title: Edtv
programme.desc: La rete True TV è in crisi. Al fine di aumentare gli ascolti la direttrice decide di seguire 24 ore su 24 la vita di un uomo normale, azione che porta a radicali cambiamenti all'esistenza del protagonista.
3 Oscar al capolavoro bellico di Sam Mendes con George MacKay e un grande cast. Due soldati inglesi sono incaricati di portare in territorio nemico un messaggio che salverebbe molte vite.

programme.title: House of the Dragon
programme.desc: Incapace di individuare i propri nemici e con richieste che le arrivano da ogni parte, Rhaenyra si rende conto che la situazione ad Approdo del Re non è quella che si aspettava.

programme.title: Mr Vendetta
programme.desc: Su consiglio della sua fidanzata anarchica, un operaio appena licenziato rapisce la figlia del suo ex capo, sperando di usare i soldi del riscatto per pagare il trapianto di rene della sorella.

programme.title: November - I cinque giorni dopo il Bataclan
programme.desc: Jean Dujardin nella pellicola che ricostruisce le indagini sugli attentati del 2015. Fred, un poliziotto dell'antiterrorismo, deve trovare i fuggitivi più ricercati di Francia.

programme.title: September 5 - La diretta che cambiò la storia
programme.desc: Il ritmo serrato del thriller per ripercorrere uno storico evento mediatico. 1972: durante le Olimpiadi di Monaco di Baviera, un commando palestinese uccide due atleti israeliani e ne prende in ostaggio nove. Una troupe della ABC documenta i drammatici eventi in tempo reale.

programme.title: L'ultimo dei Mohicani
programme.desc: Un Oscar all'epica avventura di Michael Mann con Daniel Day-Lewis. Nordamerica, 1700: durante le guerre coloniali, un indiano salva la vita alle figlie di un comandante inglese.

programme.title: Schindler's List - La lista di Schindler
programme.desc: 7 Oscar al kolossal di Steven Spielberg con Liam Neeson e Ben Kingsley. La vera storia del tedesco Oskar Schindler che salvò centinaia di ebrei dalla Shoah, impiegandoli nella sua fabbrica.

programme.title: Le assaggiatrici
programme.desc: Grande successo per il film di Silvio Soldini ispirato a una storia vera. Germania 1943. Un gruppo di donne è reclutato per testare che i pasti di Hitler non siano avvelenati.

programme.title: Il paziente inglese
programme.desc: 9 Oscar e 2 Golden Globe all’intenso dramma con Ralph Fiennes, Juliette Binoche e Willem Dafoe. Toscana, 2a guerra mondiale: un'infermiera accudisce un uomo che nasconde un tragico segreto.

programme.title: The Outfit
programme.desc: Thriller che segna l'esordio alla regia per Graham Moore, con Mark Rylance e Zoey Deutch. Chicago, anni 50: la bottega di un sarto inglese diventa l'epicentro di una faida tra gangster.
3 Oscar al capolavoro bellico di Sam Mendes con George MacKay e un grande cast. Due soldati inglesi sono incaricati di portare in territorio nemico un messaggio che salverebbe molte vite.

programme.title: Francesca e Giovanni: Una storia d'amore e di mafia
programme.desc: Simona Izzo e Ricky Tognazzi raccontano la storia d'amore tra Francesca Morvillo e Giovanni Falcone: un rapporto intenso che li vedrà uniti fino agli ultimi istanti delle loro vite.

programme.title: Donnie Brasco
programme.desc: Johnny Depp e Al Pacino immensi interpreti di un avvincente gangster-movie. Un agente FBI conquista la fiducia di un anziano mafioso, nascondendo la sua identita' fino all'ultimo.

programme.title: Mediterraneo
programme.desc: Gabriele Salvatores firma una storia sulla fuga e la ribellione premiata con l'Oscar per il miglior film straniero, con Diego Abatantuono e Claudio Bisio. Durante la Seconda Guerra Mondiale una pattuglia di soldati italiani riceve l'ordine di presidiare Syrna, isola greca sul Mar Egeo. Con la radio fuori uso e la nave a fondo, gli otto militari, provenienti da varie regioni di Italia, finiscono isolati dal mondo. Ignari che la guerra sta volgendo al termine, familiarizzano con gli abitanti del posto e qualcuno trova l'amore della sua vita. Fino all'arrivo di un aereo da ricognizione...

programme.title: The Independent: Complotto per la Casa Bianca
programme.desc: John Cena e Brian Cox nella pellicola targata Sky Original. Una giovane giornalista scopre una cospirazione che coinvolge un candidato alla Presidenza degli Stati Uniti.

programme.title: Attacco a Mumbai - Una vera storia di coraggio
programme.desc: L’inferno del terrorismo in un infuocato dramma tratto da una storia vera, con Armie Hammer e Dev Patel. Nel novembre 2008 un gruppo di jihadisti armati sbarca a Mumbai per compiere una serie di attentati in vari punti della città e prendere d’assalto un storico albergo di lusso.

programme.title: Hometown - La strada dei ricordi
programme.desc: Un documentario biografico basato sui ricordi di due artisti famosi. Il regista Roman Polanski e il fotografo Ryszard Horowitz tornano insieme in Polonia dopo 60 anni, e tra le strade di Cracovia ripercorrono l'infanzia e la giovinezza segnate dalla Shoah.

programme.title: Il piacere è tutto mio
programme.desc: Commedia romantica sulla 'sex positivity' con Emma Thompson e Daryl McCormack. Nancy, vedova matura e insoddisfatta, ingaggia un giovane gigolo' per vivere la sua prima esperienza appagante.

programme.title: Notre-Dame in fiamme
programme.desc: La pellicola Sky Original di Jean-Jacques Annaud sull'incendio che colpi' la cattedrale parigina nel 2019 e su coloro che sfidarono le fiamme per mettere in salvo tesori inestimabili.

programme.title: Ben Hur
programme.desc: 11 Oscar per il leggendario kolossal di William Wyler, con Charlton Heston. Il principe Ben Hur, caduto prigioniero per colpa di Messala, cerca vendetta nei confronti del suo nemico.

programme.title: Sotto attacco
programme.desc: Stephen Dorff sale sul ring in un action-drama dallo sceneggiatore di "American History X". Diventato campione di MMA come reazione a un padre violento, Cash si ritrova a gestire un figlio che vuole seguire le sue orme e la nascita di un bambino affetto da una rara sindrome.

programme.title: Le vele scarlatte
programme.desc: Pietro Marcello dirige Juliette Jouan e Louis Garrel dal romanzo di Aleksandr Grin. Normandia, primo dopoguerra: malvista da tutti nel villaggio una giovane sognatrice incontra l'amore.

programme.title: Potere assoluto
programme.desc: Clint Eastwood dirige e interpreta, al fianco di Gene Hackman, un thriller da antologia. Luther Whitney è un vero artista del furto, nessuna cassaforte o serratura può resistergli, ma ormai sta diventando anziano e ha deciso di ritirarsi dopo un ultimo colpo. Deve però fare i conti con un imprevisto perché la padrona della casa che Luther ha deciso di svaligiare non è partita con il marito, per intrattenersi con il suo amante che non è altri che il Presidente degli Stati Uniti. Quando la donna muore, la polizia prova a insabbiare il caso, ma per farlo occorre far tacere l'unico testimone. Eastwood e Hackman di nuovo uno contro l'altro, come ne "Gli spietati".

programme.title: Ennio Doris: C'e' anche domani
programme.desc: La storia del banchiere gentile Ennio Doris, fondatore di Banca Mediolanum. Da ragazzo che aveva un sogno a uomo d'oro della finanza italiana.

programme.title: Il piacere è tutto mio
programme.desc: Commedia romantica sulla 'sex positivity' con Emma Thompson e Daryl McCormack. Nancy, vedova matura e insoddisfatta, ingaggia un giovane gigolo' per vivere la sua prima esperienza appagante.

programme.title: C'era una volta a New York
programme.desc: Nella New York degli anni Venti, le sorelle polacche Ewa e Magda emigrano dalla Polonia a New York. Giunte a Ellis Island, scoprono che Magda è malata di tubercolosi e viene messa in quarantena. Ewa si ritrova sola e indifesa.

programme.title: Duel
programme.desc: David Mann, tranquillo commesso, si ritrova imprigionato in un pericoloso gioco al gatto e al topo in autostrada con un mostruoso camion guidato da un misterioso psicopatico.

programme.title: Le buone stelle - Broker
programme.desc: Kore-eda dirige Song Kang-ho (Parasite), premiato a Cannes. Due benevoli contrabbandieri di bambini intercettano un bebe' abbandonato in una 'baby box', ma la polizia e' sulle loro tracce.

programme.title: Bleed - Più forte del destino
programme.desc: Miles Teller nell'esaltante storia del pugile Vinny Pazienza. Reduce da un terribile incidente, il tenace campione non si arrende e torna sul ring per combattere un match leggendario.

programme.title: L'ora più buia
programme.desc: Oscar e Golden Globe a Gary Oldman nel film che racconta i primi turbolenti giorni da Primo Ministro di Winston Churchill. Nel 1940, il celebre statista inglese deve affrontare l'avanzata dei nazisti e prendere decisioni drammatiche per il bene del suo paese, ma deve fare i conti con lo scettico re e con alcuni membri del suo partito che sembrano tramare contro di lui. Oscar anche al trucco. La pellicola è stato candidata anche per la sceneggiatura, scritta da Anthony McCarten che aveva firmato anche un altro fortunato biopic, “La teoria del tutto”.

programme.title: Hurricane - Il grido dell'innocenza
programme.desc: Un magnifico Denzel Washington nella travolgente biografia di Rubin "Hurricane" Carter. All'apice della carriera, il celebre pugile viene accusato ingiustamente di omicidio.

programme.title: Sentimental Value
programme.desc: Nora e Agnes, due sorelle molto unite, si ritrovano a dover affrontare il ritorno del padre, regista carismatico ma assente nelle loro vite. L'uomo desidera realizzare il suo ultimo film e includere una delle figlie nel progetto.

programme.title: Il piacere è tutto mio
programme.desc: Commedia romantica sulla 'sex positivity' con Emma Thompson e Daryl McCormack. Nancy, vedova matura e insoddisfatta, ingaggia un giovane gigolo' per vivere la sua prima esperienza appagante.

programme.title: La Vita È Bella
programme.desc: Guido e la famiglia vivono il peso delle Leggi Razziali. Ebreo, viene deportato in campo di concentramento con il figlioletto Giosuè. L'uomo costruisce quindi un elaborato mondo di fantasie per proteggere il piccolo dagli orrori della guerra.

programme.title: Il mostro
programme.desc: Residente in un condominio alla periferia di Roma, l'innocuo e gentile Loris è scambiato per un maniaco che ha già seviziato e ucciso 19 donne. Per smascherarlo, la polizia gli mette in casa un'avvenente poliziotta.

programme.title: Johnny Stecchino
programme.desc: Capolavoro di comicita' diretto e interpretato dal premio Oscar Roberto Benigni. Nel duplice ruolo di un boss latitante e del suo sosia, l'attore toscano si trova coinvolto in una girandola di spassosi equivoci quando si innamora della moglie di un pentito che la mafia ha condannato a morte. La donna, infatti, vuole far credere che l'ingenuo giovanotto sia il marito per farlo eliminare! Sfuggito casualmente ai numerosi agguati, tra esilaranti furti di banane passati alla storia del cinema, il nostro autista forse riuscira' a salvare la pelle...

programme.title: Il piccolo diavolo
programme.desc: Roberto Benigni al fianco di Walter Matthau in una commedia diventata cult. Quando un sacerdote americano esorcizza una donna, salta fuori uno scatenato diavoletto (ITA 1988).

programme.title: Non ci resta che piangere
programme.desc: Un maestro elementare e un bidello si ritrovano, per uno strano scherzo del caso, nel 1492. Decidono di recarsi a Palos, in Andalusia, per fermare Cristoforo Colombo e impedirgli di scoprire le Americhe.

programme.title: 12 anni schiavo
programme.desc: Steve McQueen dirige Chiwetel Ejiofor e Michael Fassbender in un biopic premiato con 3 Oscar. Nella Louisiana dell'800, un violinista afroamericano viene rapito e ridotto in schiavitù.

programme.title: Fuori
programme.desc: Valeria Golino, Elodie e Matilda De Angelis, premiate con il Nastro d'Argento, nel film di Mario Martone dal romanzo autobiografico di Goliarda Sapienza. 1980: in carcere, la scrittrice instaura un legame di sorellanza con due detenute che continua quando le donne ritrovano la libertà.

programme.desc: Ron Howard dirige Tom Hanks nel terzo thriller tratto dal bestseller di Dan Brown. Firenze: il professor Langdon deve fermare un folle scienziato ossessionato dall'inferno di Dante.

programme.desc: Golden Globe a Tom Hanks, in un'avventura diretta da Robert Zemeckis. In seguito a un disastro aereo, un manager naufraga su un'isola deserta dove inizia una vita solitaria e primitiva.

programme.desc: Marc Forster dirige Tom Hanks in una pellicola dolceamara. Dopo la morte della moglie, Otto è un uomo rigido e solo. Ma la sua vita sarà sconvolta dall’arrivo di una nuova vicina.

programme.desc: 6 Oscar a una commedia cult degli anni 90, con Tom Hanks per la regia di Robert Zemeckis. Le incredibili vicende di un uomo ingenuo ma ottimista sullo sfondo di 30 anni di storia americana.

programme.desc: Tom Hanks nel dramma carcerario tratto dal romanzo di Stephen King. 1935: un gigantesco uomo di colore, dotato di poteri curativi, viene condannato a morte per omicidio.

programme.desc: Tom Hanks nel film tratto da una storia vera, nominato a 6 premi Oscar. Il capitano di una nave americana assalita dai pirati si offre come ostaggio per salvare il suo equipaggio.

Theresa Osbourne è una giornalista che ha trovato un messaggio in una bottiglia sulla spiaggia, firmato "G". Colpita dalle parole appassionate del testo, si mette sulle tracce di quell'uomo misterioso che affida al mare i suoi messaggi d'amore. Fino in North Carolina, dove vive un costruttore di barche con un doloroso passato da dimenticare.

programme.desc: Julia Roberts e Richard Gere di nuovo insieme nella commedia romantica dal regista di "Pretty Woman". Ike Graham e' un cronista di New York in cerca di un'idea per il prossimo pezzo da consegnare al suo capo, la sua ex moglie. Per caso, in un bar, sente parlare di una donna, Maggie Carpenter, che piu' di una volta ha abbandonato sull'altare i suoi fidanzati. Ike le dedica il suo prossimo articolo, finendo per scatenare l'ira della donna che ne ottiene il licenziamento. Ma Ike non si da' per vinto e decide di fare un viaggio fino nel Maryland per scoprire la verita'.

A ridosso di San Valentino, si intrecciano le storie di coppie innamorate e di single in cerca dell'anima gemella. Persone che si incontrano e si perdono di vista nei modi piu' imprevedibili. Coppie che si sfasciano, altre che si formano, qualcuno incontrera' l'amore della sua vita, qualcun altro vivra' un'avventura fugace, tutto dall'alba al tramonto, a Los Angeles. Dal regista di "Pretty Woman", il film negli Stati Uniti e' uscito nel giorno di San Valentino, incassando al debutto 57 milioni di dollari.

Entrambi sposati, si innamorano sia pure tra mille riserve che alla fine prendono il sopravvento. Tra loro cala il silenzio, ma il destino li fara' incontrare ancora un anno piu' tardi... Segnato dalla morte della figlia, Howard, un pubblicitario di New York, si chiude in se stesso perdendo ogni interesse per cio' che lo circonda. L'unica sua reazione concreta consiste nella scrittura di lettere indirizzate alla Morte, al Tempo e all'Amore. Ai suoi amici non resta che assecondarlo mentre escogitano un piano per aiutarlo a riprendere in mano la propria vita. Dal regista de "Il diavolo veste Prada". La dottoressa Ryan Stone e' alla sua prima missione spaziale, l'astronauta Matt Kowalsky e' alla guida dello shuttle per l''ultima volta, prima di ritirarsi in pensione. Un viaggio tranquillo che si trasforma presto in una catastrofe quando un esplosione distrugge la navicella causando la morte di tutti gli altri membri dell'equipaggio. I due astronauti vengono proiettati nello spazio profondo, senza alcun contatto con la Terra, apparentemente senza possibilita' di salvarsi.

programme.title: Dadaan Ka Sa Ibabaw Ng Aking Bangkay
Oo Na Mahal Na Kung Mahal
Shake, Rattle & Roll 13
programme.desc: Three tales of terror. A malevolent storm drowns the city. A man brings his family to a remote family ranch, and soon encounters the supernatural. A group of witches brings terror to an unsuspecting populace.

programme.title: Raketeros
programme.desc: A group old friends get into a heap of trouble as they try to recover a priceless dress that they lost after a wild night of partying.

programme.title: The Love Affair
programme.desc: A heartbroken lawyer finds a kindred soul in a man seeking an annulment from his unfaithful wife.

programme.title: Can't Help Falling In Love
programme.desc: Gab de la Cuesta is a high-strung career woman who got recently engaged to her longtime boyfriend. Her well-planned life suddenly becomes complicated when she discovers that she is actually married to a total stranger.

programme.title: Momshies! Ang Soul Mo'y Akin
programme.desc: Three women with totally different lives accidentally get their souls switched as they struggle with the comedic misadventures of their new worlds, they realize that their own lives and families are worth loving and living for. Jolene, a famous person who always has fans in public, Mylene - an overprotected lady who always gets pleasure and love and Karlene - a rich famous social media influencer all switch bodies but their lives did not just change, but their souls switched that leaves them with no choice but to stick together to live the peculiar lives of each other. Karlene then has to convince a group of investors to invest in her near-bankrupt hotel, but no one believes her because she is trapped in Mylene’s body. In the process of all of their imaginative scenarios, they drew closer to each other into becoming the soul sisters they are destined to be.

programme.title: Luck at First Sight
programme.desc: Joma believes that a life charm would help him win money for his debts. He then accidently meets Diane who gives him luck after they’ve been close to each other. Everything goes well for both of them until they discover their luck will disappear if one of them falls for the other.

programme.title: Kita Kita
programme.desc: Lea is a tour guide in Japan who suffered from temporary blindness and if not cured in a few weeks could be permanent. Tonyo who lives right across from Lea is persistent and determined to be her friend. They then become closer and Lea has seen the true character of Tonyo.

programme.title: No Other Woman
programme.desc: Furniture supplier Ram is happily married to Charmaine. One day, Ram lands a big client, a new luxury resort. But he needs the help of Kara, the daughter of the owner of the resort, to finalize the deal. Kara's help, however, comes with a price, because she fancies Ram to be her lover. Not before long, Kara successfully seduces Ram, even though she knows about his marriage. When Charmaine learns of the affair, she finds ways to fight for her husband's waning attention.

programme.title: Talk Back and You're Dead
programme.desc: Samantha falls in love with a hot-headed guy named Top, the leader of a gang.

programme.title: Bakit 'Di Mo Sabihin?
programme.desc: A deaf couple learns that it is not their inability to speak or hear that tears them apart.

programme.title: Dyagwar: Havey o Waley
programme.desc: Two security guards tend to the concerns of a residential compound and its collection of strange and often wacky residents.
